name: convertly-agent-stack
description: Run a governed Growth OS for Meta campaigns using Convertly intelligence, experiments, creative memory, and scale readiness.

interface.shortDescription: Build, test, and scale ads with Convertly Growth OS.
interface.longDescription: Combines Convertly analytics, experiments, creative memory, guarded scaling, native image generation, Cloudinary assets, and official Meta Ads publishing in one governed workflow.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my funnel and draft a paused Meta campaign.
Create three ad angles from my top sales page.
Diagnose weak ads and propose the next controlled test.
Evaluate which campaign is safe to scale and show the approval packet.
